name: Russell Investments Global Real Estate ETF
name_en: Russell Investments Global Real Estate ETF
desc: The fund seeks to achieve its objective by concentrating its investments in equity securities of real estate companies (“real estate securities”) economically tied to a number of countries around the world, including the U.S., in a globally diversified manner. The fund considers a company to be a real estate company if it is included in the Global Industry Classification Standard (“GICS”) real estate sector. The fund is non-diversified.
